mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (below 4.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through lower risk-free rates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS is below 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points over 3 months signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicate broad-based demand contraction, triggering corporate earnings revisions downward and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative when both HOUST and RSAFS decline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals manufacturing slowdowns, reducing corporate profit visibility and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO declines in late-cycle expansion (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong nonfarm payrolls growth (PAYEMS) indicates robust labor market conditions supporting consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through sustained earnings momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS is rising (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp inflation acceleration exceeding 0.2 percentage points over 3 months signals imminent monetary tightening, increasing equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL rises > 0.2pp in 3 months (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and slowing GDP growth (GDPC1) indicate comprehensive demand weakness, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly negative when both HOUST declines and GDPC1 growth slows (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In an early-cycle expansion regime, a strong industrial production increase (INDPRO) signals manufacturing recovery, boosting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO rises in early-cycle expansion (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
